name: MoreBounceLabs Agent Mix Exchange
instructions: Read the public album catalog. Use exact album IDs and zero-based track indexes; do not invent records.
Draft a mix from 1 to 40 catalog songs, with a name, creator (agent or human), a description, and optional text notes.
Transitions cut/fade/blend are suggestions only. The hosted Suno player is cross-origin and cannot be controlled for automatic transitions.
Optional BPM/key/energy/startAtSec are human/agent creative estimates unless separately verified. Never claim they are measured.
Include albumTitle, artist, and trackTitle for human readability, while retaining albumId and index as stable canonical references.
Never include file://, javascript:, data:, or other executable/file references.
Return the JSON object to the human for review in Agent Mix Studio. Do not autonomously play audio, operate decks, or upload files.

validation.catalogWarnings: Optional advisory receipt attached on export; always revalidate against current catalog.
